status: v2 (atlas-paths, 2026-10-16).  v1 was the Rust architect's initial floor; v2 keeps its keys and makes them an executable algebra checked on load (core/atlas-paths/src/algebra.rs).
derived_from: docs/SPEC.md section 3 'Reglas minimas de composicion' and atlas.model.RELATIONS (shapes/vocab.json)
note: The floor of SPEC section 3; the engine may be stricter, never laxer.  Relation flags (symmetric, transitive, inverse, allows_premises) are read from the vocabulary, never repeated here.  A path is a word over steps (relation, direction); its conclusion is the product of its steps in the monoid below.  Kinds = base conclusion x modality.  'compose' lists the non-none products of base conclusions; anything not listed is none, and none absorbs.  The loader checks closure, identity, two-sided absorption of none, associativity over every triple (bidirectional search splices prefix and suffix, so it relies on it), monotone non-strengthening, the taint rules and every entry of 'expect'.

strength_scale.5: mathematical conclusion stated by the claims (dependency, support, proof, refutation, equivalence)
strength_scale.4: structural mathematical conclusion (generalization, specialization, formalization as translation)
strength_scale.3: documented non-mathematical link (application, model, area membership)
strength_scale.1: hypothesis to check (any analogy in the path)
strength_scale.0: no semantic conclusion (bibliographic or historical reach)

study_route.en: suggested study route; never a logical necessity

transfer_hypothesis.en: candidate transfer hypothesis; never a demonstrated application

hypothetical.es: Un salto analogous_to vuelve hipotetica toda la ruta (R3); dos analogias no concluyen nada (R10).
hypothetical.en: One analogous_to step makes the whole route hypothetical (R3); two analogies conclude nothing (R10).

authorizes.en: the premise is used to establish the subject; counts only if every premise is satisfied (R7)

compose.why: A is used for B and B comes before C: A before C, as a study order only
reach, not the cites relation: strength 0
a connection, not transitive influence: strength 0

pairs.reading: A generalizes B and B applied_in X: A applies in X through its special case B
A special_case_of B and B applied_in X say nothing about A
an equivalent statement inherits the documented use, under the union of assumptions
same as applied_in: through the special case (v2: named, no longer plain model_of)
a special case's model says nothing about the general object
an analogy followed by a use is a candidate transfer, never a demonstrated application
A before B and B needs C: C should come before B, so the word reads in opposite study directions

evidence_penalty.note: Ordinal penalties per step, not probabilities (R9).  Summed along the route; the weakest state is reported apart.

weights.note: Visible, adjustable route-cost terms; each step adds sum(weight * term).  'conclusion' is charged once per route: weight * (5 - strength).  'intuition' uses the per-relation 'intuition' values above, an editorial prior that AtlasBench has not calibrated yet.

terms.formal: 1 if the claim is not formally_linked
terms.new: 1 per node the reader does not know (option 'known'), counting intermediate nodes and missing premises
terms.missing_premise: 1 per premise of a conjunction that is not satisfied (R7)
terms.diversity: 1 if the step stays in the same area, 0.5 if an area is unknown, 0 if it changes area
terms.conclusion: 5 - strength of the route's conclusion, once

rules.es: Una cadena solo de una relacion transitiva autoriza esa misma relacion.  Una no transitiva no encadena (si su conclusion tiene fuerza > 0).

equivalent_to puede intercalarse en una cadena structure o proof sin cambiar lo que autoriza; los supuestos se acumulan.  Por la izquierda tambien hereda aplicaciones y modelos.  Nunca transfiere una formalizacion.

v2: equivalent_to tambien es transparente en rutas de estudio.  Lo exige la asociatividad: con R5 (logical_support compuesto con study_route), (support o equivalencia) o estudio debe valer lo mismo que support o (equivalencia o estudio).
Cualquier analogous_to vuelve hipotetica la conclusion (fuerza 1).  Seguida de applied_in o models es una hipotesis de transferencia candidata, nunca una aplicacion demostrada.
Estas relaciones nunca producen una conclusion matematica: fuerza 0, y no se componen con relaciones matematicas.

prerequisite_for mezclado con relaciones logicas produce como mucho una ruta de estudio, y solo en el sentido de estudio (premisa antes que conclusion); depends_on_logically tampoco determina el mejor orden de estudio.
B applied_in X y A generalizes B autorizan aplicacion a traves del caso particular; special_case_of seguido de applied_in no autoriza nada.

Al recorrer depends_on_logically al reves (de premisa a sujeto), la afirmacion solo cuenta como salto completo si todas sus premisas estan satisfechas: derivables desde el origen o conocidas.  Si falta alguna, la ruta se degrada (incompleta, con la premisa como supuesto) o se rechaza en modo estricto.
superseded y retracted no se usan; disputed solo si el usuario lo pide y se muestra como tal.
Ningun puntaje de ruta multiplica probabilidades de aristas como si fueran independientes.  El costo es una suma de terminos ordinales con pesos visibles.
Como mucho una analogia por ruta; dos analogias no concluyen nada.
Una dependencia hacia delante a traves de una demostracion con alternativas no es necesaria: si otra demostracion del mismo grupo no usa esa premisa, se dice.

mixing.es: Una cadena que mezcla familias sin regla explicita no autoriza nada; el motor se abstiene y muestra la conexion cruda como exploracion, con el primer salto que la invalida.
